newsitem.title: USA: Clinton hails good economy, gives Fed some credit.
newsitem.headline: Clinton hails good economy, gives Fed some credit.

text.p: President Clinton hailed Friday's news of a drop in the unemployment rate and declared that the United States was enjoying an "economic rebirth."
He gave credit for the economic revival to a variety of factors, including the "diligence" of the Federal Reserve and the drive to reduce, and eventually eliminate, the budget deficit.
"Four straight years of deficit cuts have begun to put our fiscal house in order," he told reporters. "The low interest rates that resulted have produced the economic expansion."
The government reported earlier that the unemployment rate fell to 4.8 percent last month from 5.0 percent in June.
